properties.description: The seller master lives in an on-prem SQL Server behind the corporate firewall. ADF reaches it through a Self-Hosted Integration Runtime — an agent installed on a machine inside that network which makes an OUTBOUND connection to ADF, so no inbound firewall port is opened. The cloud never connects to the database directly; the SHIR pulls and pushes. In this portfolio build the same linked service can point at an Azure SQL stand-in (swap connectVia to AutoResolveIntegrationRuntime) to demo without standing up an on-prem host, but the shape here is the real on-prem pattern: SHIR + Key Vault connection string.
